summary:
Final ship version of Edition 02 built on Version C ('The Skeptic's Flip') with three targeted fixes:

1. Added a transitional open loop between the Shelter/dashstar emotional beat and the JJ behavior section: 'But the songs weren't the lesson. The lesson was watching my son.' This reconnects to the 'two-year-old taught me something' hook and gives the reader a reason to keep going through the JJ section.

2. Rewrote the Bieber transition through Farrice's walking-toward-Bieber POV. Instead of a jarring cut from 'JJ out cold' to 'The internet was deciding,' it now flows through his personal perspective: hearing the noise, having no expectations as a non-fan, then seeing what was actually happening on stage.

3. Cut the redundant contrast scene characters (girl filming, guy wanting shots, guy in expensive fit). Replaced with 'Somewhere in the middle of all of it was Jen, quietly dancing to a song from our wedding with our son.' The Coachella skepticism was already established — the bow only needs Jen.

Includes the Version C Notes set plus universal Bridge Note. All content formatted for direct copy-paste into Substack.
